description: This file defines interface declarations for alias management functions, such as lookup, quoting command lines, splitting command lines, error handling, and listing aliases, likely used in a larger command-line or shell environment.

methods.name: alias_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the command associated with a given alias.

methods.name: quote_cmdline
methods.description: Quotes the command-line arguments so they can be safely parsed.

methods.name: split_cmdline
methods.description: Splits a command line string into individual arguments.

methods.name: split_cmdline_strerror
methods.description: Returns an error message for a given error code from split_cmdline.

methods.name: list_aliases
methods.description: Populates a list with current alias definitions.
